name: aeopress
description: Author and deploy AEO-friendly static sites to aeo.press: the aeo-press-site skill plus the aeopress MCP server (hosting deploys + CMS). Set AEOPRESS_API_KEY to your aeo_host_ key.

interface.shortDescription: Author, CMS-configure, and deploy static sites to aeo.press
interface.longDescription: Build AEO-friendly static sites with Astro, define editable CMS collection templates, and deploy to {slug}.aeo.press or an ai. companion subdomain through the aeopress MCP workflow. aeo.press generates the answer-engine layer (llms.txt, sitemaps, JSON-LD, text mirrors, chat widget) at deploy time.
defaultPrompt: Build and deploy an AEO-friendly static site to aeo.press
Set up editable CMS collection templates for my site
Create an AI companion site for my existing website
